name: Ocean Point 1 By Emaar
paymentPlan: 0% Down at the sales launch. 80% During Construction. 10% On Handover
overview: Ocean Point 1 at Rashid Yachts and Marina is Emaar Properties' most recent residential development. This project aims to reinvent luxury living with its premium 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom flats, as well as distinctive 3-bedroom townhouses. This house, located in the vibrant Mina Rashid neighborhood, exemplifies sophistication by seamlessly blending urban charm and natural beauty. The project's goal is to provide a gateway to beautiful living in the heart of Dubai's historic district.
